MANGA ACTION FRAME: a single seinen historical-manga action panel painted in ink and oil — bold dry-brush sumi-ink SPEED LINES streaking along the direction of motion, radial FOCUS LINES converging on the face or the blade, motion smears on legs, mane, cloth and steel, flung ink-splatter dirt and dust, extreme foreshortening and a hard dutch tilt so the frame itself feels like it is moving; heavy black ink masses against a few hard highlights, one gold accent.
